{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
A '''''vurgat''''' was a ritual of the earth and sky that was performed by members of the [[Tarasin]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The ''vurgats'' were considered to be the highest of all Tarasin ceremonies and details of how to perform them were handed down by the Tarasin from generation to generation. The rituals were held in select groves of trees on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] that the Tarasin believed to be sacred, the ceremonies would only take place when the Tarasin leaders saw the importance of a ''vurgat'' as beyond what was normal. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] summoned the Tarasin leaders to hold a ''vurgat''.
